## Description

Ranks companies by the direction and magnitude of revisions to analyst earnings estimates or guidance, then holds improving names.

## Where it may fit

Periods of gradual information diffusion following earnings, guidance or industry changes.

## Vehicles

Equity long-short, quant equity and event-driven funds.

## Required data

Timestamped analyst consensus and revisions, earnings dates, guidance, price/volume, point-in-time coverage and corporate actions.

## Caveats

Analyst datasets are often licensed and revised historically; point-in-time snapshots are essential to avoid look-ahead bias.
